name: apyUSD
oneLiner: apyUSD is the ERC-4626 yield-bearing wrapper of apxUSD, capturing dividends and preferred-equity yield from Apyx's Digital Asset Treasury collateral.

collateral: apxUSD deposited into the Apyx ERC-4626 yield vault; apxUSD itself is backed by preferred equity shares from Digital Asset Treasury companies and liquidity buffers
pegMechanism: Users deposit apxUSD to mint apyUSD; cash dividends and preferred-equity yield accrue inside the vault, increasing apyUSD's exchange rate against apxUSD over time

mintAuthority.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over apxUSD. Ethereum and Base wrappers are UUPS proxies whose mint-critical upgrade paths are controlled by the same 3/6 Safe through chain-local Apyx AccessManagers; durable base issuance is inherited from the reviewed apxUSD issuer authority.

routeChecks.caps: The pool can mint only through the verified BridgedApyxToken mint path, which enforces the stored supply cap; it cannot change the cap or upgrade the token.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The verified BridgedApyxToken source gates mint(), burn(), and burnFrom() to the stored CCIP pool; AccessManager separately controls administrative functions and upgrades.

The pinned Apyx source identifies it as the CCIP-gated contract caller of mint/burn, while AccessManager retains administrative and upgrade functions.

controls.evidence: apyUSD inherits the reviewed apxUSD mint-authority profile; Apyx contract documentation describes apxUSD minting through MinterV0 EIP-712 signed orders and AccessManager permissions. The inherited MinterV0 path cannot raise the apxUSD supply cap.

upgradeability.controlRef: Apyx apyUSD UUPS upgrade authority - 3/6 Safe

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530746, apyUSD is a UUPS proxy with implementation 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112 and AccessManager authority 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824. At Base block 48620556, the bridged apyUSD proxy uses implementation 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824 and AccessManager authority 0x8afde6a90d2396a64eb97e8e69e7548289f78a1d. Verified Apyx source shows both implementations use UUPS and gate _authorizeUpgrade() with AccessManager restricted; current AccessManager reads resolve roles 24/25 to the same 3/6 Safe with three-day and seven-day delays. Base getCCIPPool() returned 0xEd23Fc184a3FE5d12cA92ca4f5CeFa640DECf21d. Wrapper is not paused and asset() returns apxUSD. apyUSD is an ERC-4626 wrapper of apxUSD (Apyx, BVI), backed by preferred-equity/DAT shares. Wolf & Company, P.C. runs monthly attestations, but the April 2026 engagement narrowed scope to securities only, dropping the cash/stablecoin components covered in March 2026, and apxUSD depegged twice in June 2026 (to ~$0.93 on 2026-06-04 and ~$0.78 on 2026-06-25); no independent reconciliation of the excluded reserve components after 2026-03-31 was confirmed, so reconciliation is unknown. No SEC or BVI FSC fund/issuer registration for Apyx was found, so supervision is none.
